name: Jetpack

60211.name: Flying Device I
60211.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield.
